benchmarks.note: Zachary karate club, values = degree vector, normalized. A single linear pass over the 78 edges accumulating num1/num2/den1, then a constant-time combine. Sub-microsecond, dominated by the per-edge endpoint lookups.

1000-vertex ring, values = vertex index, normalized. Pure O(E) edge scan: ~1.54 us for 1000 edges tracks the karate per-edge cost (~16 ns/edge) cleanly, confirming the linear, structure-independent scaling.
